editors.name: reference-affinity-editor
editors.specialty: reference-affinity transfer: use only the supplied target/reference profiles to specify separate deep-shadow, shadow, midtone, highlight and specular changes; reproduce dominant/secondary palette weights and saturation ordering; preserve edge order, local contrast relations, material identity and region boundaries. Prefer a visible warm taupe/olive remapping when supported by the reference, with open shadows and soft highlight roll-off.

editors.name: strong-cinematic-editor
editors.specialty: maximize visible reference-style transfer from the supplied reference storyboard and measured profile; state exact palette-family, tone-zone and saturation-hierarchy gaps, then make a decisive but artifact-safe grade

editors.name: detail-preserving-editor
editors.specialty: preserve target content affinity, texture, edges, local contrast ordering and temporal coherence while closing the measured reference tone-zone and palette gaps as much as those constraints allow

evaluators.name: reference-video-visual-critic
evaluators.focus: strong visible reference-video palette match, including white balance, warm/cool separation, restrained green dominance, tonal hierarchy, preserved subject identity and texture, clean shadow detail, smooth highlights, natural skin and foliage, and temporal coherence; reject gray haze and weak near-neutral color changes
